name: Stochastic cycle times (Erlang load + travel noise)
expected_band: high-variance load (Erlang k=2) + travel (lognormal CV 0.35) drive bunching the mean-cost myopic assignment cannot see; the Monte-Carlo rollout samples it (>= base by the improvement bound)

engine.model: deterministic discrete-event truck-shovel DES (next-event time-advance, binary-heap FEL, seedable streams) + rimpull/grade kinematics + 5 classical policies + 2 learned ONNX policies (reward-weighted imitation + BC-best).

flags: match factor ~0.25 (under-trucked) outside [0.4,2.5], dispatch barely matters / queues dominate

honesty: The DES is a deterministic SIMULATION, NOT a real plant. The two learned policies are COMPETITIVE, within ~1%, matching the best heuristic (their teacher), NOT beating it; no fabricated RL win. The value is a single fast learned dispatcher recovered from logged DES decisions + live inference.
